# "Not sent"

When WhatsApp refuses a message, the answer starts with "Not sent", gives the reason and how to fix it, and says whether a retry later is worth it. A request Whatsable refuses before sending, such as a text to someone whose 24-hour window has closed, comes back as an error instead: nothing went out either way.

An answer that starts with "Not sent, or not confirmed" means the outcome is unknown and the message may still arrive. Sending it again is a second message.

A success means WhatsApp accepted the message, not that it was delivered. get_message shows whether it was delivered, read or failed.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/concepts#not-sent
